Digital marketing is increasingly about agency. People want control over their time, information, culture, and trust. That means present well-being matters more than distant promises, AI is turning search into a conversational tool, and younger audiences expect to participate in and remix the culture they consume.

Nostalgia is no longer just a feeling; it’s a way to anchor experiences in familiarity while letting people co-create new moments. Sustainability claims are under scrutiny, and brands need tangible proof, not vague statements.
